description: Implement the 'What is Kelza' section (section 4) with all four parts: core definition, three pillars, ecosystem summary, and bridge to Live Product Experience.
steps: Create css/what-is-kelza.css following the BEM pattern from css/meet-kelza.css. Include: base section hidden by default (opacity:0, transform), --visible class to reveal, __element--revealed for progressive child reveals, editorial typography using design tokens, a three-column CSS Grid for pillars (collapses to 1-col mobile), generous whitespace/padding, responsive breakpoints at 640px/768px/1024px, reduced motion media query, all colors/spacing/typography from variables.css only.
Add @import './what-is-kelza.css'; to css/main.css after the meet-kelza.css import.

Add the new <section id='what-is-kelza-section'> in index.html AFTER the closing </section> of meet-kelza-section and BEFORE </main>. Content structure: Part 1 - one large centered placeholder statement '[One-sentence definition of Kelza]' with premium display typography. Part 2 - three-column grid with three pillars: '[Discover meaningful people.]', '[Build trusted relationships.]', '[Grow through communities.]' - each pillar has a concept heading and brief placeholder description. Part 3 - a text-based ecosystem summary (2-3 sentences explaining how the 9 modules work together as one platform, referencing but NOT duplicating the SVG from meet-kelza-section). Part 4 - bridge sentence '[Now let us experience how Kelza works.]' that transitions to the next section. Use semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy (h2 for section title, h3 for subsections), data-reveal attributes on child containers, aria-label on the section, aria-hidden='true' initially.

Create js/sections/WhatIsKelzaSection.js following the exact pattern from MeetKelzaSection.js: constructor gets element by ID 'what-is-kelza-section', reveal() adds 'what-is-kelza--visible' class + removes aria-hidden + sets up IntersectionObserver on [data-reveal] children, hide() reverses, destroy() disconnects observer. Use 'what-is-kelza__element--revealed' as the reveal class for children. Keep the class under 400 lines and no function over 60 lines.
Update js/app.js: import WhatIsKelzaSection from './sections/WhatIsKelzaSection.js', instantiate it, and call reveal() inside the DOMContentLoaded handler, after meetKelzaSection.reveal().
acceptance_criteria: index.html contains a new section with id='what-is-kelza-section' placed after meet-kelza-section
The section has four distinct parts: core definition, three pillars (grid), ecosystem summary (text only, no SVG), and bridge
css/what-is-kelza.css exists and uses only CSS custom properties from variables.css
js/sections/WhatIsKelzaSection.js exists following the MeetKelzaSection controller pattern
All content uses placeholder text in square brackets
Three pillars use CSS Grid with responsive collapse
Semantic heading hierarchy is maintained (h2 then h3)
Section is intentionally short and editorial in style
No Canvas, Three.js, or heavy animations used
No ecosystem SVG duplication from meet-kelza-section
verification: Grep index.html for 'what-is-kelza-section' to confirm section exists
Grep index.html for 'meet-kelza-section' closing tag appears BEFORE 'what-is-kelza-section'
Confirm css/what-is-kelza.css exists and contains no hardcoded color/spacing values (only var() references)
Confirm js/sections/WhatIsKelzaSection.js exports a class with reveal(), hide(), destroy() methods
Grep what-is-kelza.css for 'prefers-reduced-motion' to confirm accessibility support
Grep index.html for 'grid' class or css for 'grid-template-columns' in what-is-kelza.css to confirm grid layout for pillars
findings: Implementation complete. All verification checks pass: section placed after meet-kelza-section, CSS uses only var() references with no hardcoded values, grid-template-columns used for 3-col pillar layout, reduced motion support included, JS controller follows MeetKelzaSection pattern exactly, app.js imports and instantiates after meetKelzaSection. Node syntax check passes on the JS file.
